items.name: click-powerup
items.title: ClickPowerUp
items.description: A bracketed button that arms on hover and powers up with an accent flash and bracket burst on every click.

items.name: sticky
items.title: StickyButton
items.description: A magnetic button whose body and label are pulled toward the cursor from a wide field, with parallax depth and tilt.

items.name: shiny-button
items.title: ShinyButton
items.description: A glossy, gradient-styled button with a layered inner glow and a glint that sweeps across on every click.

items.name: movie-pass
items.title: MoviePassButton
items.description: A cinema ticket button that tears along its perforation on click, hinging open or snapping apart.

items.name: minimal
items.title: MinimalButton
items.description: A quiet dark button with a hairline ring, inner highlight, soft drop shadow, and a chevron that nudges on hover.

items.name: dither-button
items.title: DitherButton
items.description: A button with an animated 4x4 ordered-dither wave background and a knockout label.

items.name: evil-eye-button
items.title: EvilEyeButton
items.description: An obsidian pill with a burning evil eye behind its label that tracks the cursor across the page, focuses on hover, and blinks.

items.name: troll-button
items.title: TrollButton
items.description: A button that dodges the cursor until it runs out of stamina, then gives up and lets you click it.

items.name: chrome-button
items.title: ChromeButton
items.description: A metallic pill whose border is a ring of flowing liquid chrome around a solid face that follows the light or dark theme, with pill, compact, and icon sizes.

items.name: brutal-button
items.title: BrutalButton
items.description: A NeoBrutalism style button with sharp shadows and stark borders.

items.name: aqua-button
items.title: AquaButton
items.description: A glossy pill button inspired by Apple's Aqua interface, with layered highlights and a soft inner glow.

items.name: 3d-button
items.title: ThreeDButton
items.description: A minimal 3D button with a clean deck-style press and sliding click sheen.

items.name: frame-button
items.title: FrameButton
items.description: A futuristic button with springy corner markers that spread on hover and lock on when pressed, plus a scan sweep.

items.name: highlight-button
items.title: HighlightButton
items.description: A button with a cursor spotlight, a border that lights up near the pointer, and a ripple from wherever you click.

items.name: glitch-button
items.title: GlitchButton
items.description: A button with randomized RGB-split glitch bursts, a scanline overlay, and a flickering label.

items.name: command-button
items.title: CommandButton
items.description: A button with a global keyboard shortcut, shown as keycaps that sink as you hold each key.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: A copy button that briefly shows the copied text above itself, so you see exactly what landed on the clipboard.

items.name: reveal-button
items.title: RevealButton
items.description: A button that reveals a hidden secret value on hold or toggle, with a blur-in animation and an eye icon indicator.

items.name: demonic-button
items.title: DemonicButton
items.description: A hold-to-summon button: keep pressing to raise ridged devil horns from behind it while a canvas fire builds into a roar.

items.name: hold-button
items.title: HoldButton
items.description: A hold-to-confirm button whose inner fill grows from 0 to 100%; release early to shake and abort, hold to the end to fire the action.

items.name: doubt-button
items.title: DoubtButton
items.description: An escalating-confirmation button that makes you click through increasingly absurd, guilt-tripping prompts before the real action finally fires.

items.name: slide-to-detonate
items.title: SlideToDetonate
items.description: A slide-to-confirm safety gate that makes you drag a handle across a fuse before the real action detonates.

items.name: morph-status-button
items.title: MorphStatusButton
items.description: A single button that morphs through idle, loading, success, and error states in place, with no layout shift.

items.name: cooldown-button
items.title: CooldownButton
items.description: A button that locks itself behind a draining radial timer after each click to stop spam and double-submits, taunting you while you wait.

items.name: realistic-switch
items.title: RealisticSwitch
items.description: A latching push switch, a raised box that sinks into its socket when pressed, stays down and glows while on, and springs back up on the next press.

items.name: confetti-button
items.title: ConfettiButton
items.description: A ringed dark button with a sparkle icon that fires a restrained confetti burst on click.

items.name: ash-burst-button
items.title: AshBurstButton
items.description: A ringed dark button that glows like an ember on click and erupts ash that collides with it via Matter.js physics, piling onto its surface.

items.name: minecraft-button
items.title: MinecraftButton
items.description: A pixel stone menu button that cracks every few taps, shatters into chips, and drops itself as a bobbing item you pick up to respawn it.
